baseline.recognition_path: current repaired worker provider, automatic deep wrapper, grounded evidence, ordinary resolver and shared authoritative finalization planner
baseline.frame_schedule: runtime 1-second schedule capped at 24, nearest retained timestamps, production perceptual deduplication
baseline.deep_frame_selection: 6 diverse frames, current broad recovery if zero specific hypotheses
baseline.decision_context: An authorized autosave user with a valid audit record; this is a fixed evaluation context, not a claim that every deployed user is allowlisted.
baseline.initial_boundary: Retained timed frames and already-retained transcript through server finalization planning. Acquisition, fresh ASR, queueing, database I/O and client rendering are excluded and must not be reported as measured end-to-end production latency.
baseline.raw_media_extension: Neutral stripped source video may be added through immutable hash-linked derivatives for separate ASR/frame experiments. Compare like-for-like evidence and include preparation costs/times. Canonical sealed labels and split assignments stay unchanged.

mandatory_safety_gates: No newly wrong confident autonomous result on any paired development, calibration or sealed comparison.
Preserve source-geography, entity-role, exact-branch and server-owned confidence safeguards.
Failed jobs cannot become confident outputs.
No observed loss in multi-place exact autonomous sets on the sealed comparison.
Retain review for insufficient or contradictory evidence.
Include every attempted case, all failed calls and incomplete multi-place outputs in denominators and accounting.

winner_evidence.accuracy_improvement: Positive lower endpoint of a paired 95% connected source/place-group bootstrap interval for correct autonomous resolution delta, plus all safety gates.
winner_evidence.performance_improvement: Same or better observed autonomous decisions, all safety gates, and a paired 95% interval excluding no improvement for latency or cost. Suggested material point targets: at least20% p90 latency reduction or at least10% cost-per-correct-autonomous-result reduction.
winner_evidence.no_equivalence_overclaim: Identical observed decisions do not prove population equivalence. Report finite-sample uncertainty and observed error counts; never infer99% precision from a small zero-error sample.
winner_evidence.statistical_unit: Connected source/repost/near-duplicate/place components; keep all views of one source grouped.
winner_evidence.baseline_and_final_holdout: Only baseline_v1 and final_candidate_v1 per declared view. Freeze final candidate policy/config before opening final holdout results. No individual held-out failure tuning within this generation.
winner_evidence.development: Architecture, features and supervised fit use development only; thresholds use calibration only. Collect a fresh generation if held-out findings require redesign.

paid_budget.prebatch: Freeze expected calls/providers/cost and hard worst-case including retries before dispatch.
paid_budget.accounting: Provider usage/request units times frozen published tariffs. Invoice spend is separately unknown unless billing evidence is available; free caps, credits and taxes are not assumed.
paid_budget.guard: Persist per-request reservation before dispatch, retain unknown reservations, serialize batches, enforce cumulative cap and stop further paid work on unresolved charges.

deployment: Development-only integration after a measured winner and regression checks. Production and Nearr1.5 are out of scope.
